name: WARNING: Dutch Bros Picture Perfect Freeze (Frozen Caramel & Chocolate Overload)
whyItWorks: Frozen espresso blended with high-sugar ice cream mix, lined with caramel drizzle and dark chocolate sauce, and capped with heavy Soft Top cream. Massive dairy fat + sugar shock induces rapid gut dumping.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Avoid Dutch Bros Freezes. Order an iced decaf Americano with oat milk.
